name: @dialpad/dialtone-mcp-server

tools.name: search_utility_classes
tools.description: Search for CSS utility classes to style HTML elements. Use when query mentions CSS properties (padding, margin, display, flex, width, border, color) or CSS values (8px, 100%, center, auto, bold). Returns classes like d-p-100, d-d-flex, d-w100p, d-mbs-auto.

query.description: CSS property and/or value (e.g., 'padding 8px', 'display flex', 'width 100%', 'margin block start auto')

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-50, default 15)

tools.name: search_tokens
tools.description: Search for design tokens (CSS variables) from Dialtone's design system. Use when query mentions token categories (color, spacing, layout, font, size, shadow) or semantic names (primary, positive, critical, warning, info, foreground, background). Returns tokens like --dt-color-foreground-primary, --dt-spacing-100.

query.description: Token category, name, or value (e.g., 'color primary', 'spacing 400', 'layout 200', 'font family')

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-50, default 15)

tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Search for Vue components from Dialtone's component library. Use when query mentions UI elements or component names (button, modal, input, dropdown, checkbox, avatar, badge, card, tooltip). Returns components like DtButton, DtModal with props and usage info.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-30, default 10)

tools.name: search_icons
tools.description: Search for icons from Dialtone's icon library and learn how to use icon components. Use when query mentions icon names (bell, arrow, calendar), categories (alerts, communication, time), visual concepts (notification, warning, email), or when user asks how to use/implement icons. Icons are imported from @dialpad/dialtone-icons/vue, not @dialpad/dialtone-vue. Returns icon names like 'alert-circle', 'bell-ring', 'calendar-plus' with tree-shakable usage examples.

query.description: Icon name, category, or keyword (e.g., 'notification', 'arrow up', 'calendar', 'warning')

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-50, default 20)

tools.name: search_documentation
tools.description: Search Dialtone documentation for usage patterns, accessibility rules, migration guides, design principles, and how-to guidance. Use when query mentions behavior (loading, disabled, deprecated, migration, validation, dark mode), patterns (do/don't, composition, recipe), or asks why/how/difference ('modal close behavior', 'tooltip on disabled', 'DtOldPopover replacement'). NOT for finding components / icons / tokens / utility classes by name — use search_components / search_icons / search_tokens / search_utility_classes for those. Returns documentation sections with content excerpts.

query.description: 2–5 keyword phrase — topic, behavior, or concept (e.g., 'button loading state', 'modal outside click', 'tooltip disabled', 'migrate DtOldPopover')

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-30, default 10)
